# Mohammad Moin

> Mohammad Moin is an independent software engineering consultant and corporate technology trainer based in Bengaluru, India (IST, UTC+5:30). He works at the intersection of building and teaching: delivering production web and mobile applications while designing practical technical upskilling programs for engineering teams.

## Who this is
Mohammad Moin is an independent software engineering consultant and corporate technology trainer. His professional practice combines hands-on production engineering with enterprise technical training rather than treating consulting and teaching as separate disciplines.

Primary professional positioning:
- Independent Software Engineering Consultant
- Corporate Technology Trainer

Primary areas of expertise:
- Frontend Architecture
- Angular
- React
- React Native
- Terraform & Azure
- Corporate Technology Training

Profile: https://mdmoin7.github.io/portfolio/about/

## Consulting
- Independent software engineering consulting for web, mobile and enterprise applications
- Frontend architecture, application modernization, scalable application development and engineering enablement
- Recent engagement: React Consultant, JLL (Jan 2024 – Mar 2025) — re-architected legacy AEM/Java web components to React within a 10-15 engineer team spanning multiple countries; orchestrated a shared SolidJS design system translated into React and Angular
- See: https://mdmoin7.github.io/portfolio/consulting/

## Training
- Corporate technology training and enterprise engineering upskilling
- Practical programs for cohorts of 20-50 engineers, with repeat engagements from returning clients
- Clients include IBM, Amazon, Walmart, SAP and Dell
- 15,000+ engineers trained across 350+ sessions
- Curricula authored: React & NestJS Intermediate Track (40h, API-first), Angular Intermediate Track (40h + optional Day 6 on NgRx/micro-frontends), React JS Development Track (40h, capstone-based), GenAI-Powered .NET Application Development (reference course)
- See: https://mdmoin7.github.io/portfolio/training/
